headline: Tabled two Styrofoam items until the next meeting, approved the August minutes unanimously, and noted Brian Romer will step down as of 2027.
summary: The group reviewed upcoming events, including the September 19 book swap moving to HMLS and the September 12 Longest Table event. Two Styrofoam items were tabled until the next meeting. Guest Lydia King spoke about the composting ordinance and other waste ideas.
decisions: Approved the August 2026 meeting minutes unanimously by all members in attendance.
Tabled the proposal to create a petition for Styrofoam data until the next meeting.
Tabled the poster on appropriate Styrofoam types, including physical samples, until the next meeting.
Brian Romer will step down from the committee as of 2027.

decision_evidence.quote: Minutes August 2026 meeting Approved unanimously by all members in attendance.
Create a petition for Styrofoam data. ... Tabled until next meeting.
Poster indicating what kinds of Styrofoam are appropriate/acceptable for our event, including physical samples. ... Tabled until next meeting.
Brian to step down from the committee as of 2027
